title: GateReceipt/v1
description: Receipt emitted by an SRL work-package acceptance gate. Provenance only; never a scientific claim. Canonical JSON contract: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN/Infinity, trailing newline.

wp_id.description: Work-package identifier the gate covers (e.g. WP-B10).

overall.description: Aggregate gate result. PASS only if every check PASSed.

checks.description: Per-check results keyed by check id (e.g. B10-01). Each value carries at least a status.
